comment: Probe: the first derivation of the MLOW/codec work. It resolves the
wa_opus.cc cluster (encode/decode/media-init) by independent facts, not
by recorded indices, then proves the execution pipeline with a
malloc/write/read round-trip of one synthetic frame. It deliberately does
NOT call the codec yet: the instance structs behind opus_codec_encode
need their layout re-derived first (see the repo notes). The manifest
records module hash, resolved indices/slots and output hashes, so a
second run over the same bytes must be byte-identical.
